spans.s:
कृप् 1. कृप्, प्, f., Ved. (occurring only in
inst.), beautiful appearance, beauty, splendor.
—कृप-
नीऌअ (for कृपा-˚), अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. one whose home is
splendor, dwelling in splendor, epithet of Agni; (Sāy.)
the support of sacred rites.

कृप् 2. कृप् (connected with rt. क्रप्),
cl. 1. A. कर्पते, to have pity or mercy
on; cl. 10. P. कृपयति or कृपापयति, -यितुम्,
to be weak; to pity; to mourn, grieve, lament;
[cf. Gr. ἔλπω]

कृप, अस्, m., N. of a man described in the Veda
as a friend of Indra; (अस्), m. and (ई), f., N. of the
son and daughter of the sage Śaradvat, (he performed
severe penance and thereby alarmed the jealous Indra,
who sent a nymph to tempt him, but without
success; however, twin sons were born to the sage
in a clump of grass (शर-स्तम्बे), who were found
by king Śāntanu and out of pity (कृपा) taken home
and reared as his own; the daughter, Kṛpī, married
Droṇa, and had by him a son called Aśvatthāman;
the son, Kṛpa, became one of the privy council at
Hastināpur, and is sometimes called Gautama, some-
[]
times Śāradvata. According to the Hari-vaṃśa and
Viṣṇu-Purāṇa, Kṛpa and Kṛpī were only distant
descendants of Śaradvat. According to others, Kṛpa
= Vyāsa or = a son of Kṛṣṇa.)
—कृपी-पति, इस्,
m. a N. of Droṇa as husband of Kṛpī.
—कृपी-
पुत्र or कृपी-सुत, अस्, m., a N. of Aśvatthāman
as son of Kṛpī.

कृपा, f. pity, tenderness, compassion; N. of a
river.
—कृपा-दृष्टि, इस्, f. a look with favour, a
kind look.
—कृपाद्वैत (˚पा-अद्˚), अस्, m. one
of the Buddhas or deified saints of the Buddhists.
—कृपान्वित (˚पा-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, or कृपा-मय,
अस्, ई, अम्, or कृपालु, उस्, उस्, उ, or कृपा-वत्, आन्, अती,
अत्, pitiful, merciful, compassionate, tender.
—कृपा-
मिश्र, अस्, m., N. of a son of Deva-miśra.
—कृपा-
हीन, अस्, आ, अम्, pitiless, unfeeling, unkind.

कृपण, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, inclined to grieve;
pitiable, miserable, poor, wretched, feeble; low, vile;
miserly, stingy; avaricious; arising from pity, caused
by pity; (अम्), ind. miserably; (अस्), m. a worm; (अम्),
n. wretchedness, misery; स-कृपणम्, miserably,
pitiably; [cf. कार्पण्य.]
—कृपण-काशिन्, ई, इनी,
इ, Ved. looking suppliantly, looking desirous; ex-
pressing a desire (?).
—कृपण-त्व, अम्, n. misery;
wretchedness; miserable condition.
—कृपण-धी,
ईस्, ईस्, इ, little-minded.
—कृपण-निन्दा, f. ‘censure
of the miser,’ title of a chapter of the Sārṅgadhara
Paddhati.
—कृपण-बुद्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, little-minded.
—कृपण-वत्सल, अस्, आ, अम्, kind to the poor.

कृपाण कृपाण, अस्, m. (said to be fr. rt.
कृप् for rt. कॢप्?), a sword, a scymitar, a sacrificial
knife; (ई), f. a pair of shears or scissors; a dagger.

कृपणाय, nom. A. कृपणायते, to feel
miserable.

कृपणिन्, ई, इनी, इ, miserable, one who is in
misery.

कृपण्य, nom. P. कृपण्यति, to wish, desire,
be a suppliant for anything, pray for, obtain by
entreaties; (in A. also कृपणते.)
कृपण्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, Ved. one who praises.

कृपाय, nom. A. कृपायते, -यितुम्, to mourn,
grieve, lament, have pity.

कृपाणक, अस्, m. a sword, a scymitar; (इका),
f. a dagger, a knife.

कृपीट कृपीट, अम्, n. (said to be fr. rt. 2.
कृप्), underwood, wood, forest; fire-wood, wood,
timber; water; the belly.
—कृपीट-पाल, अस्, m.
a rudder or large oar used as one; the ocean; air,
wind.
—कृपीट-योनि, इस्, m. fire.
